body.x: Nikon showcased its D500, a top-notch camera with the latest specifications of its flagship DX-format DSLR camera lineup, at “CES (Consumer Electronic Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT electronics and tech exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.

With its upgrades in AF system, continuous shooting, and 4K UHD video support, D500 possesses the best shooting performance. By using the newly developed Multi-CAM 20K Autofocus sensor with 153/99 AF points, it can stably capture objects in various conditions.

Furthermore, it enables users to easily capture moments they want, as it shoots 10 frames per second. By using the power memory with larger capacity, it can shoot up to 200 large images, including RAW and original files.
In particular, it can capture 4K UHD(3840×2160) videos at up to 30 frames per second and output uncompressed videos in real time, on monitors and displays via HDMI ports.

It is also equipped with a 20.9 MP DX-format CMOS sensor and EXPEED 5 image processor. With ISO sensitivity of 100 to 51,200, which is expandable up to ISO 1.64 million in its Hi 5 setting, it can produce stable and clear images, even in high-sensitivity photograph mode. Its recognition performance is also improved with a 180K-pixel RGB sensor.

It possesses a touch-sensitive 3.2-inch multi LCD that can be tilted upward by 90 degrees, and downward by 75 degrees. It is also convenient as it supports “SnapBridge”, an application that can wirelessly connect a digital camera to smart devices via Bluetooth low energy (hereafter BLE).

It adopts a monocoque structure utilizing “Sereebo”, a high-elastic, carbon-fiber composite material. Its size is 47 × 115 × 81mm (W x H x D), and it weighs about 760g (camera body only). It will be launched in March 2016, and the price is yet to be determined.

Nikon Imaging Korea CEO Yamada Koichiro said: “The D500 is an attractive DSLR camera that is easily controllable and convenient with many professional-level features. We are very happy to showcase this product at CES 2016.”

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
